messages:
jim_acmeops: Hey team — since yesterday we started seeing p99 spikes for streaming responses. Customers see very slow first-byte (TTFB) around 400-600ms and total for some requests is 2-4s. Non-streaming requests also have a handful of slow tails. This is impacting a dashboard refresh flow. Example req ids: abc123, def456. Can you triage?

sara_support: Thanks for the heads up @jim_acmeops — sorry for the disruption. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl + headers) and the region/tenant? We'll scope ASAP.

jim_acmeops: repro: 
```\ncurl 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?stream=true' \\\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\
  -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":256}' -N
```\nTenant: acme-prod, region: us-east-1. We see first chunk delayed, then normal flushes. Happened ~2026-03-15T13:00-14:00 UTC.

sara_support: copying in @mike_oncall and @eli_infra. We may also try a non-streaming run for comparison (stream=false).

mike_oncall: grabbing logs now. @eli_infra can you check proxy-level coalescing metrics for acme-prod? I want to see flush_window_ms and chunk_coalesce events.

eli_infra: seeing a bump in proxy coalescing counts across us-east nodes starting 2026-03-15T12:58 UTC. Example log: 
```\n[2026-03-15T13:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 tenant=acme-prod route=/v1/generate model=gpt-open-16k flush_window_ms=50 coalesced_chunks=1 first_chunk_delay_ms=512 total_time_ms=3204
```\n
eli_infra: the runtime changed default coalescing from 20ms -> 50ms in the recent flush-window tuning rollout (shipped 2026-03-14). That explains TTFB bump for streaming-heavy tenants. Non-streaming total tails might be downstream backpressure reacting to batching changes.

sara_support: ok — can we do a tenant override for acme-prod to revert flush_window to 20ms while we decide?

mike_oncall: yes. I can push a tenant-level override (x-redwood-tenant-flush-ms) to 10ms as hotfix. Pushing now and will monitor p95/p99.

deploy_bot: deploy started: tenant-override(acme-prod) set flush_ms=10 by mike_oncall @ 2026-03-15T13:12:05Z

mike_oncall: override applied on 6 nodes. Watching metrics.

eli_infra: initial metrics: first_chunk_delay median dropped from ~420ms -> ~70ms for acme-prod in the next 2m. p99 trending down but still watching. Non-streaming tails reduced slightly.

jim_acmeops: confirms client-side: TTFB back to expected levels, overall UX improved. Thanks! :tada: Any follow-up to prevent regression?

nina_product: action items: 1) rollback the global default change or make it opt-in, 2) add a console tenant toggle for flush window, 3) add alerting on sudden flush_window change impact (TTFB delta). Filing a ticket.

mike_oncall: agree. I'll open a postmortem and a short-term policy to avoid global runtime defaults without staged canary by tenant.

sara_support: noted — closing loop with customer and scheduling postmortem sync. Jim — send any additional traces if you spot recurrence and we'll reopen.

jim_acmeops: will do. appreciate the quick turnaround.
